description: xz-packed fx2-cmix binary with the english.dic payload compressed by the same fx2-cmix binary in no-dictionary mode
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Same native cmix bytes and decoded english.dic bytes as fx2cmix_wrapped_xz_v1. The wrapper decodes english.dic.cmix through the bundled cmix binary, then invokes the same dictionary-mode -c/-d path as the parent package.

10m_inherited_from_fx2cmix_wrapped_xz_v1.roundtrip_basis: Same native cmix bytes, byte-identical decoded dictionary, same dictionary-mode arguments, and byte-identical 1KB archive output.

100m_inherited_from_fx2cmix_wrapped_xz_v.roundtrip_basis: Same native cmix bytes, byte-identical decoded dictionary, same dictionary-mode arguments, byte-identical 1KB archive output, and inherited parent 100MB roundtrip result.

verdict: Promote as the current best measured 100MB percentage package. This is a packaging improvement only; it does not change the entropy model.
